mapper.select: select cs.id, cs.course_id as courseId, cs.week_day as weekDay, cs.start_section as startSection, cs.end_section as endSection, cs.location, c.course_name as courseName, c.credit, u.real_name as teacherName from course_schedule cs inner join course c on cs.course_id = c.id inner join course_selection sel on sel.course_id = cs.course_id left join user u on c.teacher_id = u.id where sel.student_id = #{studentId} order by cs.week_day, cs.start_section
